properties.description: Validates and transforms NYC 311 operational records into trusted data for downstream consumption.

sources.name: srcBronze
sources.description: Add source datasetRead raw NYC 311 service requests from the Bronze layer.

transformations.name: normalizeDates
transformations.description: Convert raw date strings into typed timestamps.

transformations.name: evaluateQuality
transformations.description: Evaluate business data quality rules and classify invalid records.

scriptLines: normalizeDates derive(quality_reason = case(     trim(coalesce(unique_key, '')) == '', 'MISSING_ID',     isNull(created_ts), 'INVALID_CREATED_DATE',     trim(coalesce(closed_date, '')) != '' && isNull(closed_ts), 'INVALID_CLOSED_DATE',     coalesce(closed_ts < created_ts, false()), 'NEGATIVE_RESOLUTION_TIME',     lower(trim(coalesce(status, ''))) == 'closed' && isNull(closed_ts), 'CLOSED_WITHOUT_DATE',     'VALID' ) ) ~> evaluateQuality
